title: A Survey on Evaluation Metrics for Music Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Critical analysis of existing evaluation metrics (such as Pitch Histogram Entropy and FAD) and datasets, highlighting their reliance on Western music theory (e.g., 12-tone tonality) and data, which renders them ineffective for evaluating non-Western, microtonal, or polyrhythmic musical traditions.
Review of human evaluation protocols in music generation research, identifying how listener ratings are heavily influenced by participant demographics such as age, education, and musical background.
